title: beads issue IDs in code comments are opaque to external contributors
description: Comments in port.c reference beads issue IDs: 'wolfssl-tm1' (RSA not implemented, line ~1193), 'wolfssl-1rl' (HKDF via DO_KDF, line ~1339), 'wolfssl-2ed' (TLS devId assignment, line ~1479). These IDs are opaque to anyone without access to this project's beads tracker. A contributor reading the code on GitHub cannot resolve them. Suggested fix: convert each to a self-contained TODO comment that describes the limitation and the path forward without requiring tracker access, or convert to public GitHub issues and reference the URL.
